sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Removes damage reflect, damage reduction, and continuous heal effects.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 220. Success value 100. 4x physical damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Blinds for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Paralyzes for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs and special debuffs.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 60 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 9000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 9000
